general_skill: Work in this order: (1) think about where the target object usually is, (2) go to that receptacle, (3) if it is a closed drawer/cabinet/fridge/microwave, open it before looking inside, (4) take the object, (5) go to the destination receptacle, (6) put the object. You can hold only one object at a time. You must be AT a receptacle to open/take/put there. Always copy an admissible action string exactly.

skills.pick_and_place: Find the target object, take it, then go to the destination receptacle and put it there. Objects are often on countertops, tables, shelves, or inside drawers/cabinets.
skills.pick_two_obj_and_place: You must place TWO objects of the SAME type. Pick and place the first, then search again for the second identical object and place it in the same receptacle. The task is only done when both are placed.
skills.look_at_obj_in_light: Take the target object first, then go to a floor lamp or desk lamp and use 'use <lamp>' to turn it on while holding the object. Do NOT put the object down before using the lamp.
skills.pick_heat_then_place_in_recep: Take the object, go to the microwave, open it, heat the object with 'heat <object> with microwave', then carry it to the destination receptacle and put it.
skills.pick_cool_then_place_in_recep: Take the object, go to the fridge, open it, cool the object with 'cool <object> with fridge', then carry it to the destination receptacle and put it.
skills.pick_clean_then_place_in_recep: Take the object, go to the sinkbasin, clean it with 'clean <object> with sinkbasin', then carry it to the destination receptacle and put it.
